steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Ugh, ahem...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, are you alright?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm okay. But you, we're lucky you didn't jump on it this time.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You reacted faster than me. At least everyone in this bit of the hall's basically fine, thanks to your shield.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I couldn't protect everyone.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The smoke's everywhere it'll go. Looks to me like the Colonel only took light harm, and they're retreatin' out another door.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The Bard...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh... He was stood too close to the bomb.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What a pity... it's not everyone who can step forth for others at bladepoint. He was a poet, but he had the courage to match an excellent soldier.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I wish so badly he could've died with meaning.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: While the enemy's still outside, Bagpipe, let's evacuate the survivors.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe...?
Bagpipe stares blankly out of the window.
In that single moment, it is as if the sound of battle vanishes.
A tremendous energy bursts from the depths of the night.
Without a flicker of a flare, from the statue to the city hall, all living beings are instantly, silently snapped to ash.
And immediately after, an army seeps out from the night and the ashes, without a sound.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I've never, ever seen... fire like this before.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The head Caster, who is she?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, move away, quick!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You're too close to the window. Given the energy just now, the next attack could blow straight through the walling.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Yes, Leader.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm just...

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: Help me... hurry, help me...

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: My leg... argh, ow!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Focus on rescue. Pull back for now.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Who was that? Are there still any Victorian soldiers alive?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's the enemy all over!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: By the speed of this march, the spectre force infiltrated this city long ago.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: District Eleven to Seventeen have been occupied far too quick... Can't be... Is this the reason the Colonel went to search those blocks?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We need to withdraw south of District Ten. The troops and the spectre force are doing battle there right now.

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: D—Don't go off to battle, ta... take me back to somewhere I can hide in safety first... I can't let the heads find I'm still alive...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Take you back? With all of this goin' on right now, you ought to be taken straight to prison!

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: Lighter... wurgh... ow...

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: I... I'll pay you... I can even gift you a city block... so long as you...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, can I use my own ways to shut him up?!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We'll ask a few things more while he's still awake.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Who was that heading the Casters just now?

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: ...That's... The Leader...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The spectre force's leader?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What... who is she?

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aren't you compatriots? You had the absolute gall to bring people into your house while knowin' nothin'?!

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: She's... the Duke's guest...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Duke...? Which one?!

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: I can't...

steps.name: Wildly Ambitious Baron
steps.text: Urgh—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: He... died?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The spectre force did that...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Don't they band together? Why are the spectre force targeting their own?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let's get out of here first.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You, hold still.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Who are you? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: My, um... I was just delivering medicine... You all started fighting before I knew it.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Delivering medicine? Who for? Is it the Victorian soldiers?

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: I... aheh... Rhodes Island's medicine is for Infected use, and we don't pay mind to patients' identities...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Your movements are suspect.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: It's alright now, Will.

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: Outcast—The Lass! You—You came just in time!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hey, you got the comms this afternoon, didn't you? Rhodes Island's called an emergency stop to all daily business in County Hillock.

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: I got it, yeah, but...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: —You wanted to finish delivering the rest?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're a good kid. Pass me the meds, and I'll deliver what's left for you.

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: Lass, what on Terra's going on outside? There was fighting everywhere in just a blink!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Several hundred years of accumulated resentment put to use, turned into a fire ready to destroy all.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: And let me tell you, it's only just getting started.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hurry on back. Now that I'm here, my highest priority's making sure we don't lose a single Rhodes Islander.

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: Alright, Lass... Right, I just caught sight of Miss Jane near District Seventeen... She... She comes to the office so often, we all half-treat her as a Rhodes Island Operator!

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: She's a Victorian soldier, and with what these rioters think, they won't just let her go!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'll amend my previous statement—we're not losing even half a Rhodes Islander.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Leader, I've evacuated everyone I could.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Do you have any injuries?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: None. It's been a little reassurin' in a way, while coming to blows all night. Aside from that head Caster, and a couple strong folk, most of the rest of the soldiers are still normal people.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: They've gotten trainin', but their discipline's not much to speak of. With equal numbers, and an open confrontation, they wouldn't be any match for our team.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You're giving it preconditions. Besides, their main opponent is the barracks.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You're right, Leader. If they're going to fight them, the barracks won't be on the front foot.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Any more discoveries?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The weapons they're armed with are all first-grade. Just now when I went rescuin' those few officials and nobles, someone tried to sneak on me at the corner, and after I knocked him out, I brought what he was holdin' back.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: A Victorian standard military crossbow?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's a model from two years ago, but it's been modified. Look at these two coils and the guide rail underneath.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: A Shield-piercing Rounds Accelerator.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I'm not too smart with crossbows, and I never saw this in the army or at school. Is this our tech?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Doesn't seem too like it.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, have I overlooked something, maybe...? We came to investigate the theft of Originium products, correct?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Yes. The spectre force want to fend against our regular army without a doubt, so they'd need a lot of weapons for sure.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: But the crossbow in our hands reveals a lot of information.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Firstly, the enemy has secretly been plotting for longer than we thought; secondly, beyond the goods they've stolen from our possession, there are other powers that have been funding their operations in the long term.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: In other words, in this instance, here, they had no plans to take up new equipment and rush to arms.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right! So in that sense, where did the weapons we lost most recently go?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: So you've realized where the problem is—the spectre force finally show themselves, but the Originium products that disappeared in County Hillock are still missing.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I hope Triangle's found some new leads.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: (Hushed) Here, Leader.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Is your group still doing alright?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Snare's been lightly injured, the others can still operate. It's just, everyone's tired and hungry. Our situation's not that nice for sure.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Were you involved in combat yesterday, too?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Yes. Since nightfall, large numbers of enemies have suddenly poured out. It's like they were just lying in wait in the greenhouses and irrigation systems all this time—

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That seems to be exactly where they hid themselves. For the troops not familiar with the agricultural plates, it'll be exceedingly difficult to win that hide-and-seek.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: We fought face-to-face with a small wave of them, there were far too many enemies in my view, and we hid away on my lead, all the way until daybreak.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You've done very well. Can you return to the city?

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Haha. That'll be a little tricky, Leader. Half of them have gone into the city, and the other half are still around everywhere.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Leader, our group all agrees, we should continue with our initial task.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: We've discovered a transport vehicle. Your guess was right, someone really did use an agriculture transport route to convey these Originium products somewhere.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Not that much each time. These ones today, most likely, are the last of them.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: These ones today? Where are you?!

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: We're hidden onboard the transport vehicle right now.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: I can't risk talking too much. Worried they might hear. Next time we make contact, you'll know who the thief was.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: This is too dangerous!

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Haha... Leader, you and Bagpipe, be careful too.

steps.name: Triangle
steps.text: Triangle, out.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Bagpipe, inform Cello ASAP, we're returning to the barracks now.
'...Districts Three through Nine have fallen...'
'...The city hall, the newspaper, and Good Mary's Hospital are simultaneously under enemy attack...'
'...Baron Paulet's wife sent an urgent cable—she's lost contact with her husband since early morning—she's requesting the barracks send help...'

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Colonel! I have something to say.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Let her in.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: I hope you aren't here to give me nonsense, Skamandros. As you can see, our enemy is savage. I have no time to contest with you again.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Colonel, the enemy is hiding in the agricultural plates.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: That's where they were concealed. On top of that, they're not all in the city—they have even more hands.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I suggest you send someone fast to evacuate the citizens at the ag plates, and carry out emergency decoupling of the central city and those plates ASAP, to avoid letting even more of the enemy into the city!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: I don't need you instructing me on what to do.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Colonel! It may not be in our power to prevail if we solely depend on the stationed troops, and my platoon, to cope with enemy forces infiltrating the city. We have to ensure the enemy gets no further reinforcement—

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: You can go.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Colonel?!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: It's my business how County Hillock is preserved.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: In the principal duty that is upholding the security of the Victorian Empire, we should be united!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Hill, show her out.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Did you hear that, Hill? The ag plates, ha! They're hiding in the ag plates! I deduced as much long ago. Who else would open the door for the ghosts?!

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Yes, Colonel. The Tarans are assisting them.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: How are the artillery battalion's preparations?

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: According to plan. The final batch of material will arrive at around noon.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Good. Have them speed up the remodeling. Every time I even think of those disgusting things bounding around in my city, it has me eager to finish this.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Oh, yes, Skamandros and her subordinate. The wolf from Londinium is still biting fast and won't let go. You've heard, haven't you? They have a helping hand outside.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Give the command. Regardless of the means, we cannot let anyone stand in the way of our plans.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: Yes, Colonel.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: As for Skamandros, before we're done, she cannot be left to act freely.

steps.name: Adjutant Hill
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: I have realized something... thanks to her talking-to.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Why were our movements last night at Bolton's already known to the enemy?!

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Skamandros... no, it couldn't be. Though she shares that weakness and naivete innate to her kind of nobility, she has a highly secured loyalty to the Empire.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Hmph... it seems rabble is ultimately rabble, their base nature always stiff to bend.

steps.name: Colonel Hamilton
steps.text: Within these last few hours, one more thing must be done. And it's long overdue.
